title: Identity Test Environment Completion
outcome: The Auth0-enabled NoorPath release environment can execute every customer, operator and platform identity path because the Documents persistence module is registered, discoverable, migrated and covered by the permanent migration guardrails.
actor: Authenticated NoorPath test customers, approved operator members, platform administrators and release reviewers validating protected journeys.
modules: Documents owns document requirement, submission and audit persistence.
Accounts continues to own Auth0 sessions, normalized AccountId derivation and return-to behavior.
Operators continues to own active membership and permission checks.
Release infrastructure owns test-only identity provisioning, managed allow-lists and deployment validation.
routes: Authenticated customer -> My Journey -> owned booking -> documents and visa status
Approved operator member -> operator workspace -> document, visa, support and cancellation queues
Platform administrator -> protected platform and publication routes
Foreign customer -> another customer's booking -> safe not-found response
Unauthenticated visitor -> protected deep link -> Auth0 sign-in -> exact return destination
acceptance: DocumentsDbContext is registered in the migration module registry.
The Documents migration has generated EF designer metadata and exactly one frozen model snapshot.
A fresh Documents test database accepts all registered migrations and has no pending model changes.
The deployed Neon database contains the documents requirements, submissions and audit tables.
The real Auth0 smoke-test account has an active approved operator membership with the four approved permissions and explicit platform allow-list access.
The account can access its owned demo journey while foreign demo journeys remain inaccessible.
Customer Documents, Operator Documents and Operational Support no longer fail because of absent persistence objects.
Existing document policy, malware, private-storage and authorization behavior remains unchanged.
No UI page, route contract, styling, commercial policy or customer production data is modified.
Identity evidence belongs to the exact deployed commit and records any genuinely external blocked step without treating it as passed.
Product Owner approval is required before merge; deployment remains limited to the NoorPath release/test environment.
policyDecisionsRequired: Use the existing Auth0 Google identity only as an all-access smoke-test account.
Keep Delhi and Mumbai demo journeys as foreign-account isolation fixtures.
Do not enable production document storage, cancellation execution or payment execution in this slice.
exclusions: Auth0 tenant redesign, phone OTP or account recovery.
New role administration or operator-provisioning UI.
Document upload storage enablement or real passport data.
Payment provider, refund execution or cancellation-policy changes.
